integrity: Proof reconstructs the coset classification and quotient-generator condition; finite checker is corroboration rather than a proof of universality.
scientific_limitations: Odd finite abelian Takasaki quandles only; counts all ordinary lattice complements, not strong set-theoretic complements. Closest 2020 source only accessible by abstract; independent audit outstanding.
title: Complement multiplicities in odd Takasaki subquandle lattices
